feed.title: NPR Topics: Business
feed.subtitle: Reporting on the money that flows through our economy, from Wall Street financial firms to Silicon Valley tech giants, small businesses, consumers, employers and workers. Plus podcast episodes of Planet Money and The Indicator.

entry.title: Plans for a data center threaten scenic wilderness and dark skies in West Virginia
entry.summary: Residents are fighting back against plans for a project that would span thousands of acres near the Monongahela National Forest and popular outdoor recreation, ski areas and dark sky sites.

entry.title: Oil company earnings skyrocket — again
entry.summary: Oil companies are reporting another quarter of sky-high profits as the war in Iran pushes up the price of oil — and prices at the pump.

entry.title: Hackers steal over $6 billion from crypto exchange Binance in staggering heist
entry.summary: More than $6 billion worth of cryptocurrencies were stolen from Binance, the world's biggest crypto exchange. It's the biggest cyber heist ever — and many suspect North Korea may be behind it.

entry.title: Blockchain intelligence firms link North Korea to $6.3B hack on Binance
entry.summary: The world's biggest cryptocurrency exchange reported Thursday that approximately $6.3 billion was impacted in an apparent hack.

entry.title: Binance flags 'potential security issue,' says approximately $6.3 billion impacted
entry.summary: It wasn't immediately clear the extent of the damage hackers might have been able to cause, and Binance had not explicitly confirmed that funds had been pilfered. The company said its teams are "working around the clock" to resolve the issue.

entry.title: The two most interesting risks to Anthropic
entry.summary: Anthropic gave a 94-page list of risk factors in its S-1 this week. Two of them stood out.

entry.title: Candy prices got you scared stiff? What to know about the cost of Halloween this year
entry.summary: Prices for candy, the most popular Halloween purchase, and gum have risen 7.7% in one year and are up more than 18% in two years, according to the latest federal data.

entry.title: 'Affordability? For who?' Voters decide between helping homeowners or public services
entry.summary: Candidates across the U.S. have paid lip service to affordability issues. In Florida, the question of how to save voters money, and at what cost, is literally on the ballot.

entry.title: How powerful is Elon Musk? How his political influence compares to past U.S. moguls
entry.summary: Critics say the tech entrepreneur's enormous wealth has given him too much political power. But when stacked up against other notable American moguls, historians say he's not unique.

entry.title: With days to go before the midterms, data shows the U.S. economy is doing well
entry.summary: GDP grew at an annual rate of 3.4% in the third quarter in the last major read on the economy ahead of the midterm elections — but many Americans continue to struggle with affordability.
